title: booinspace AZJ2 modules refreshed to the 2026.11.15 release
items: Replaced the booinspace/galaxyxr-modules list with the 12 modules in the azj2-modules-2026.11.15 release: Window Controls, Saved Workspaces, Wi-Fi ADB, Framebuffer10, mic gain boost, MV-HEVC eye fix, no low-light toast, OpenXR QUALITY, passthrough anywhere, QuestLHSync, root face tracking and wear-aware blanking.
Removed the obsolete standalone Borderless, Rotation and curvature recovery records; the combined Window Controls package replaces them, and Saved Workspaces requires Window Controls 0.1.70+.
Added AZJ2 target firmware with source links, cross-repo family keys, and the AZF3-only note for 4uva4ek Framebuffer10 0.5.1.
